quarter_semantics: Calendar quarters. 2026Q2 means the three months ending 30 June 2026, and the snapshot is as at that date. Every published quarter is a COMPLETED reporting period; no partial quarter is published as an actual.

measures.name: exposure
measures.label: Exposure
measures.definition: Drawn balance plus the whole undrawn commitment. Distinct from EAD, which converts only part of the undrawn amount.
measures.null_means: the facility was not on the book at this date

measures.name: ead
measures.label: Exposure at default
measures.definition: Drawn balance plus the credit conversion factor applied to the undrawn commitment. NOT the same number as exposure.

measures.name: drawn_amount
measures.label: Drawn amount
measures.definition: The balance actually outstanding.

measures.name: undrawn_commitment
measures.label: Undrawn commitment
measures.definition: Committed but not drawn.

measures.name: gross_carrying_amount
measures.label: Gross carrying amount
measures.definition: The carrying amount before impairment allowance.

measures.name: limit
measures.label: Limit
measures.definition: The approved facility limit.

measures.name: weighted_model_ecl
measures.label: Modelled ECL
measures.definition: Scenario-probability-weighted expected credit loss from the governed calculator, BEFORE any management overlay.
measures.formula: sum over scenarios of scenario_weight * scenario_ecl

measures.name: overlay
measures.label: Management overlay
measures.definition: Separately identified management overlay. Never blended into a parameter and never inferred from the modelled result.

measures.name: reported_ecl
measures.label: Reported ECL
measures.definition: Modelled ECL plus the separately identified overlay. This is the impairment allowance the Cockpit reports.

measures.name: weighted_twelve_month_pd
measures.label: Weighted 12-month PD
measures.definition: Scenario-weighted probability of default within twelve months. A DESCRIPTIVE summary: multiplying it by weighted LGD and EAD does not reproduce the weighted ECL.
measures.null_means: not measured for this facility at this date

measures.name: weighted_lifetime_pd
measures.label: Weighted lifetime PD
measures.definition: Scenario-weighted cumulative probability of default over the remaining measurement window. The sum of marginal default probabilities, never an annual PD multiplied by a number of years.

measures.name: weighted_lgd
measures.label: Weighted LGD
measures.definition: Scenario-weighted effective loss severity, weighted within each scenario by where default mass actually falls.

measures.name: coverage_ratio
measures.label: ECL coverage
measures.definition: Reported ECL as a proportion of exposure.

measures.name: collateral_coverage_ratio
measures.label: Collateral coverage
measures.definition: Allocated recognised collateral as a proportion of exposure, capped at one. Allocation is pro rata to exposure across the facilities that share an asset, so a shared property is counted once.

measures.name: utilisation
measures.label: Utilisation
measures.definition: Drawn balance over limit.

measures.name: rating_rank
measures.label: Rating rank
measures.definition: Ordinal position on the demo master scale; higher is weaker. The numeric partner of the grade label, so a portfolio movement can be expressed in notches without averaging letters.

measures.name: stage
measures.label: IFRS 9 stage
measures.definition: 1, 2 or 3 under the stated demo SICR policy.

measures.name: days_past_due
measures.label: Days past due
measures.definition: Days past due at the date.

measures.name: ratio_dscr
measures.label: DSCR
measures.definition: Cash available for debt service over scheduled principal plus cash interest, on a twelve-month basis.
measures.null_means: the denominator is zero or negative, or no statement is available; not a DSCR of nought
measures.period_basis: annualised from the latest available statement

measures.name: ratio_net_debt_to_ebitda
measures.label: Net debt / EBITDA
measures.definition: Total debt less cash over annualised EBITDA. Debt, not total liabilities.
measures.null_means: EBITDA is zero or negative, so the multiple is not meaningful

measures.name: ratio_interest_coverage
measures.label: Interest coverage
measures.definition: EBIT over interest expense, annualised.

measures.name: ratio_current_ratio
measures.label: Current ratio
measures.definition: Total current assets over current liabilities.

measures.name: ratio_quick_ratio
measures.label: Quick ratio
measures.definition: Current assets less inventory over current liabilities.

measures.name: covenants_breached
measures.label: Covenants breached
measures.definition: Count of covenant tests breached at this date.

measures.name: covenant_worst_headroom
measures.label: Worst covenant headroom
measures.definition: The smallest headroom across this borrower's tests, in the metric's own units. Negative means breached.

dimensions.name: rating_approved_grade
dimensions.label: Approved rating
dimensions.note: A label. Never averaged; use rating_rank for arithmetic.

dimensions.name: group_id
dimensions.label: Connected group
dimensions.note: Aggregate to the group by summing facility rows once. A borrower with three facilities is one borrower.

cockpit_quarter.grain: One row per facility per reporting date.

cockpit_credit_history.grain: One row per facility per reporting date, across every published quarter.

cockpit_borrower_financials.grain: One row per borrower per statement, as at each reporting date the statement was the latest available one.
cockpit_borrower_financials.note: Statements repeat across reporting dates because the same statement stays the latest available one for several quarters. Summing a financial across facility rows is therefore double counting, and the semantic rules forbid it.

cockpit_collateral_assets.grain: One row per collateral asset per valuation version per reporting date.

cockpit_collateral_allocation.grain: One row per collateral asset per facility per reporting date.

cockpit_covenant_tests.grain: One row per covenant obligation per test date.

cockpit_scenario_parameters.grain: One row per facility per scenario per reporting date.

cockpit_risk_curves.grain: One row per facility per scenario per future period.

cockpit_macro_paths.grain: One row per geography per predictor per forecast vintage per scenario per forecast period.

cockpit_movements.grain: One row per facility per reporting date, against its matched prior period.
cockpit_movements.note: A versioned cached derivative of the snapshots, not an independent source of truth. It carries the data version it was computed from and is regenerated with the book.

portfolio_summaries.name: portfolio_twelve_month_pd
portfolio_summaries.label: Portfolio 12-month PD (EAD-weighted)
portfolio_summaries.note: An EAD-weighted average, not a mean of the column. The weight is shown in the Trace because an equally weighted PD and an exposure-weighted PD are different numbers.

portfolio_summaries.name: portfolio_coverage
portfolio_summaries.label: Portfolio ECL coverage
portfolio_summaries.note: A ratio of components. It is NOT the average of the facility coverage ratios, and the two differ whenever exposure is not evenly spread.

portfolio_summaries.name: portfolio_dscr_components
portfolio_summaries.label: Portfolio DSCR (ratio of components)
portfolio_summaries.note: A ratio of summed components. Distinct from the distribution of borrower DSCRs and from their exposure-weighted average; the Cockpit says which one it is reporting.

portfolio_summaries.name: portfolio_dscr_weighted
portfolio_summaries.label: Portfolio DSCR (exposure-weighted average of borrower ratios)
portfolio_summaries.formula: sum(ratio_dscr * exposure) / sum(exposure) over borrowers with an available DSCR
portfolio_summaries.note: Borrowers with no available DSCR are excluded and counted, rather than treated as zero.

portfolio_summaries.name: concentration_top_group_share
portfolio_summaries.label: Largest connected group share of exposure
portfolio_summaries.formula: max over group_id of sum(exposure) / total sum(exposure)
portfolio_summaries.note: Facility rows are summed once per group. A borrower with three facilities is one borrower and is not counted three times.

forbidden.detail: A measure declared not_additive may not be summed. Ask for its approved weighted form instead.
A rating grade is a label. Aggregate rating_rank, and report the result in notches.
A PD reported without its horizon is two different measures wearing one name.
Borrower financials repeat across a borrower's facility rows. Deduplicate to borrower grain before summing.
weighted PD x weighted LGD x weighted EAD is not the weighted ECL and may not be presented as a way of computing it.
A currency movement has no basis-point form. Report it in the reporting currency.
